model-and-fictional-inputs.text: Alice is a fictional spelling for model key forty-two. The Lean naming lifecycle keeps the registry root equal while the name holder maintains a destination or recovers control. The address and policy numbers in the fixture are not live Cardano assets.

presenter-path-1015-minutes.text: Pause the short recording after each frame. Ask what changes in the name record, what remains equal in the registry, and why an unsigned maintenance or wrong recovery reveal refuses.

play-the-lean-rehearsal.text: The embedded eighty-column cast runs the Lean lifecycle program and asserts the returned rows. It shows a model rehearsal, with no node transaction or devnet receipt.

what-the-dated-card-still-needs.text: The dated naming card needs a release-bound connected devnet run with transaction IDs, policy identities and fresh record readbacks. The model cast cannot stand in for those observations.
